conclusions: Exact nonce12/12+wrapped49marker02 tuple separates AES envelope from original nonce24/24+wrapped48 legacy. No shared-key_version algorithm overload and no authentication-failure fallback.

Frozen v2 AAD prefix console.mail.credential NUL 02 then purposebyte1payload/2wrap then unchanged Aad.encode binds algorithm/domain/purpose/org/account/field. Version1KEK remains unchanged; no historical reseal.
Mixed SMTP/IMAP field formats work because each field dispatches its own complete tuple while shared row key_version stays1. Actual PgMailStore partial-update test remains required.

Zeroizing guards must own DEK/seal/open mutable plaintext before any fallible operation; aes_open returns only Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, validates32byte key/12byte nonce and authenticated length safely, then successful plaintext transfers to SecretBox. Retain coarse errors/redacted output.
RandomizedNonceKey uses provider-owned96bit generation andAES256GCM; no custom nonce or cipher implementation. Fixed known-answer open must hit production primitive.
rollout_conditions: Old XChaCha-only reader cannot read AES: before enabling any new writes, stop/drain every old API/send/sync/worker reader and ensure rollback artifact also dualreads, or ship separate reader-first phase. Current design is not a zero-downtime rollout implementation.
After firstAESwrite, rollback only to AES-aware artifact. Never bulk decrypt/reseal historical data to support an old binary; retain ciphertext and keys.

Per-KEK aggregate wrap-invocation budget at most2^32 includes failed/discarded/retried calls across processes,restarts,replicas and restores. Documentation alone is not production evidence; qualification must establish count/enforcement or earlier rotation/stop trigger. Rotation remains separate unfinished work.
bounds: Legacy Aad.encode preserved; application uses bounded UUID strings and fixed field labels. No codec reinterpretation or arbitrary historical bytes normalization.
Root current cipher source is already evolving; this is frozen design/source review, not acceptance of the current implementation diff.
No FIPS certification/production qualification claim. Tests use synthetickey/passwords only.
